dashboardGuide.indicatorsDesc: 8 core indicator cards sit at the top of the dashboard. Each card delivers advanced data extracted from the options market in real-time.

netGex.title: NET GEX
netGex.desc: The <cyan>total gamma exposure</cyan> in the options market. See at a glance how much gamma dealers are holding.
netGex.positive: Positive → Dealer long gamma → Volatility suppressed, price stable
netGex.negative: Negative → Dealer short gamma → Volatility amplified, trend accelerated
netGex.tip: A sharp change in GEX signals a shift in the market''s character
netGex.guide1: GEX positive + price sideways → Range trading (iron condor, credit spreads)
netGex.guide2: GEX negative + momentum → Trend trading or straddle/strangle entry
netGex.guide3: GEX rapidly flipping sign → Increase stop-loss range and reduce position size

gammaFlip.title: GAMMA FLIP
gammaFlip.desc: The price where dealer gamma position <gold>flips between long ↔ short</gold>. The market''s behavior changes completely at this level.
gammaFlip.tip: SHORT label means currently in short gamma zone — potential for sharp moves
gammaFlip.guide1: Price above Gamma Flip → Stable zone, range-bound strategies work well
gammaFlip.guide2: Price below Gamma Flip → Volatile zone, use wider stops and smaller positions
gammaFlip.guide3: Near Gamma Flip → Regime transition possible, avoid large directional bets

squeeze.title: SQUEEZE
squeeze.desc: <gold>Gamma squeeze probability</gold> shown as percentage and grade (LOW/MED/HIGH). Higher values mean greater chance of dramatic price movement.
squeeze.high: HIGH — 58%+ squeeze warning, prepare for volatility
squeeze.guide1: Squeeze > 70% + OPI one-directional → Enter in OPI direction with tight stops
squeeze.guide2: Squeeze moderate + high IV → Sell premium strategies, iron condor
squeeze.guide3: Squeeze low → No catalyst, avoid gamma-dependent plays

vwap.title: VWAP Distance
vwap.desc: Distance between current price and <cyan>VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price)</cyan> in %. The key reference level for institutional traders.
vwap.tip: The closer to 0%, the closer to a VWAP test — directional decision imminent
vwap.guide1: Price above VWAP + rising volume → Uptrend confirmed, longs favorable
vwap.guide2: Price below VWAP + increasing volume → Downtrend confirmed, shorts/puts favorable
vwap.guide3: Price crossing VWAP → Potential trend reversal, watch for confirmation

maxPain.title: MAX PAIN
maxPain.desc: The price that maximizes option holders'' losses at expiration. Price tends to converge toward this level as expiry approaches.
maxPain.guide1: OE week: Price below Max Pain → Call spread or long stock (magnetic pull up)
maxPain.guide2: OE week: Price above Max Pain → Put spread or take profits (magnetic pull down)
maxPain.guide3: Large Max Pain-price divergence near OE → Expect sharp convergence

callWall.title: CALL WALL
callWall.desc: The strike with the highest call open interest — acts as a powerful <cyan>resistance level</cyan>. Breaking through can trigger a gamma squeeze.
callWall.guide1: Near Put Floor → Expect bounce, sell puts or buy calls
callWall.guide2: Near Call Wall → Expect resistance, sell calls or take profits
callWall.guide3: Floor/Wall range narrowing → Imminent breakout, prepare directional trade

darkPool.title: DARK POOL %
darkPool.desc: Percentage of total volume traded in <gold>dark pools (institutional off-exchange)</gold>. Higher means large-scale institutional positioning is underway.
darkPool.guide1: DP 60%+ with flat price → Institutional accumulation, prepare for breakout
darkPool.guide2: DP surging + price declining → Possible institutional distribution, manage risk
darkPool.guide3: DP low but volume surging → Retail-driven move, sustainability questionable

shortVol.title: SHORT VOL %
shortVol.desc: Short sale volume ratio. High short volume + bullish momentum = <gold>short squeeze</gold> signal.
shortVol.guide1: Short 50%+ with price rising → Short squeeze potential, follow momentum
shortVol.guide2: Short 50%+ with price falling → Intensifying downward pressure, hedge with puts
shortVol.guide3: Short Vol suddenly dropping → Short covering underway, potential reversal signal

atmIv.title: ATM IV
atmIv.desc: Tracks real-time <cyan>At-The-Money Implied Volatility</cyan> based on current price. Higher IV means the market expects larger price swings.
atmIv.guide1: IV < 30%: Buy options (calls/puts) → Profit on volatility expansion
atmIv.guide2: IV > 70%: Covered calls, put writing, premium selling strategies
atmIv.guide3: IV spikes then declines → IV Crush in progress, close long option positions

pcRatio.title: PUT/CALL RATIO
pcRatio.desc: <cyan>Put/Call Ratio</cyan> measures market sentiment by dividing <gold>put volume by call volume</gold>. Above 1.0 indicates put dominance (bearish), below 0.7 indicates call dominance (bullish). Extreme readings are often contrarian signals.
pcRatio.guide1: P/C > 1.2 with support holding → Contrarian buy opportunity
pcRatio.guide2: P/C < 0.5 with price surging → Overheating warning, consider taking profits
pcRatio.guide3: P/C rapid shift (0.5→1.5) → Sentiment reversal, check for catalyst events

gexRegime.title: GEX REGIME
gexRegime.desc: <rose>GEX Regime</rose> analyzes market makers' <gold>Gamma Exposure</gold> to determine the volatility structure. STABLE suppresses price swings, EXPLOSIVE amplifies them. The regime directly affects which option strategies are optimal.
gexRegime.guide1: STABLE → Range-bound, iron condor / credit spread favorable
gexRegime.guide3: Flip Zone → Reduce position size, tighten stop-losses

impliedMove.title: IMPLIED MOVE
impliedMove.desc: <purple>Implied Move</purple> shows <gold>the market's expected price range</gold> derived from ATM option prices. Displayed as ±% from current price, there is approximately 68% (1σ) probability that price stays within this range by the nearest expiry.
impliedMove.guide1: IM ±8%+: Directional buys costly—use spreads to reduce premium
impliedMove.guide2: IM low = cheap premiums → Long straddle/strangle opportunity
impliedMove.guide3: IM consistently > actual move → Premium selling has edge

commandGuide.subtitle: Command center that analyzes premium indicators and options structure for individual tickers in real-time
commandGuide.overviewDesc: Command is a tactical center that analyzes <cyan>10 premium indicators</cyan> for individual tickers in real-time. Institutional-grade tools like <gold>VOL REGIME</gold>, <cyan>CONVICTION</cyan>, <rose>SHORT SQUEEZE</rose>, and <emerald>ANALYST TARGET</emerald> are available on a single screen.
commandGuide.indicatorsDesc: The 10 premium indicator cards at the top of Command deliver critical data for real-time, daily, and swing trading decisions.

volRegime.title: VOL REGIME
volRegime.desc: Fuses gamma exposure, IV, and squeeze probability to diagnose the current <gold>volatility regime</gold> in 4 stages (STABLE/COILING/LOADED/ERUPTING). A 100-point score instantly reveals market temperature.
volRegime.tip: In LOADED/ERUPTING zones, reduce position sizing and tighten stop-losses.
volRegime.guide1: STABLE  Range-bound strategy, trade around VWAP
volRegime.guide2: COILING  Prepare for breakout, consider options straddles
volRegime.guide3: LOADED/ERUPTING  Trend follow only, counter-trend entries are dangerous

conviction.title: CONVICTION MATRIX
conviction.desc: A <gold>composite confidence score</gold> that fuses 5 data points: <cyan>SMA trend</cyan>, VWAP, P/C Ratio, GEX, and Flow. Grades A through F provide an instant directional read.
conviction.bear: D-F (0-44)  Bearish bias, sell signals concentrated
conviction.tip: Conviction 80+ combined with stable VOL REGIME = high-probability entry point.
conviction.guide1: Grade A: Strong buy conviction  Consider scaling into position
conviction.guide2: Grade C: Neutral  Watch from sidelines or keep minimal exposure
conviction.guide3: Grade F: Strong sell pressure  Consider shorts or hedging

vwapCard.title: VWAP
vwapCard.desc: Shows the percentage distance between the current price and <cyan>VWAP (Volume-Weighted Average Price)</cyan>. This is the most critical <gold>positioning benchmark</gold> for institutional traders.
vwapCard.tip: Within 0.3% of VWAP = critical decision zone  watch for breakout or rejection.
vwapCard.guide1: +2% or more: Overbought warning  Consider short-term profit-taking
vwapCard.guide2: Within 0.5%: VWAP test zone  Focus on breakout/breakdown direction
vwapCard.guide3: -2% or more: Potential bearish shift  Confirm support before entry

shortSqueeze.title: SHORT SQUEEZE
shortSqueeze.desc: Measures <rose>short squeeze risk</rose> by combining short interest (SI%), days to cover, and short volume ratio.
shortSqueeze.tip: Days to Cover 3+ combined with SI% 15%+ is the classic short squeeze setup.
shortSqueeze.guide1: HIGH/CRITICAL  Reduce short positions, beware of chasing rallies
shortSqueeze.guide2: Positive momentum + HIGH SI%  Short covering rally possible
shortSqueeze.guide3: LOW  Limited short influence, focus on fundamentals

analystTarget.title: ANALYST TARGET
analystTarget.desc: Displays Wall Street analyst <emerald>rating distribution</emerald> with buy/sell ratios. Shows the 5-tier breakdown from Strong Buy to Strong Sell with total analyst count.
analystTarget.tip: Buy ratio 80%+ = strong market consensus formed, but consider contrarian perspective too.
analystTarget.guide1: Buy 90%+: Strong consensus  solid basis for mid-long term positions
analystTarget.guide2: Buy 50-70%: Divided opinions  additional analysis needed
analystTarget.guide3: Mostly Hold: Direction uncertain  focus on short-term event-driven approach

instRadar.title: INST RADAR
instRadar.desc: Tracks institutional investor accumulation/distribution patterns through <purple>dark pool trade ratio</purple> and <cyan>block trade</cyan> frequency. Displayed as ACCUMULATION/DISTRIBUTION/NEUTRAL signals.
instRadar.accum: ACCUMULATION  Dark pool 40%+ and 3+ blocks  institutional buying
instRadar.dist: DISTRIBUTION  Dark pool below 20% and 1 or fewer blocks  institutional selling
instRadar.tip: ACCUMULATION + buy consensus is strong evidence for mid-long term upside.
instRadar.guide1: ACCUMULATION: Institutional buying zone  Buy opportunities on pullbacks
instRadar.guide2: DISTRIBUTION: Institutional selling  Consider taking profits on bounces
instRadar.guide3: NEUTRAL: Limited institutional participation  Analyze retail flow instead

trendPhase.title: TREND PHASE
trendPhase.desc: Diagnoses the current trend phase via <emerald>SMA 50/200</emerald> moving average crossover status. Detects GOLDEN Cross (bullish) and DEAD Cross (bearish) in real-time.
trendPhase.golden: GOLDEN  SMA 50 > SMA 200, bullish trend shift
trendPhase.dead: DEAD  SMA 50 < SMA 200, bearish trend shift
trendPhase.neutral: NEUTRAL  No crossover, existing trend continues
trendPhase.tip: GOLDEN Cross + CONVICTION Grade A = ideal buy signal combination.
trendPhase.guide1: GOLDEN Cross: Mid-long term buy thesis  Use trailing stops
trendPhase.guide2: DEAD Cross: Defensive strategy  Consider downside hedges
trendPhase.guide3: SMA distance within 3%: Crossover imminent  Monitor for direction change

fundamental.title: FUNDAMENTAL
fundamental.desc: A <emerald>financial health score</emerald> combining <cyan>PE</cyan>, <gold>ROE</gold>, FCF, revenue growth, margins, and D/E ratio. A-F grading on a 100-point scale for quick fundamental assessment.
fundamental.aGrade: Grade A (80+)  Excellent financials, growth + profitability balanced
fundamental.bGrade: Grade B (60-79)  Good, some weaknesses exist
fundamental.cGrade: Grade C or below  Needs improvement, increased risk
fundamental.tip: PE below sector average with ROE 20%+ = undervalued growth stock.
fundamental.guide1: Grade A: Valuation appeal  Core mid-long term position
fundamental.guide2: Grade B: Selective approach  Enter after confirming growth momentum
fundamental.guide3: Grade C or below: Speculative  Consider short-term event trading only

earnings.title: EARNINGS
earnings.desc: Displays the next <gold>earnings date</gold>, D-Day countdown, estimated EPS, and quarter info. Volatility spikes sharply during earnings season, making advance preparation essential.
earnings.upcoming: Imminent (D-7 or less)  IV rising, options premiums increasing
earnings.far: Earnings far out  Fundamental-based position building possible
earnings.tip: IV surges from D-3 before earnings  Buy options before, sell just before announcement.
earnings.guide1: Earnings D-7: IV rising  Review straddle strategies
earnings.guide2: Earnings day: Direction unpredictable  Reduce position sizing
earnings.guide3: Post-earnings: IV Crush  Options selling strategies favored

related.title: RELATED
related.desc: Shows real-time performance of sector peers with <cyan>high correlation</cyan> to the current ticker. Get a quick read on overall sector momentum.
related.divergent: Different direction  Individual ticker event possible
related.tip: Entire sector rising but this ticker falling = check for stock-specific issues.
related.guide1: Sector-wide rally: Momentum trades valid  Ride the trend
related.guide2: Only leader rising: Rotation possible  Watch laggards
related.guide3: Sector decoupling: Analyze individual events  Check news

commandGuide.gammaDesc: <gold>Options-derived tactical levels</gold> and <cyan>gamma engine</cyan> analysis. Sets short-term trading ranges with Support/Resist/Max Pain levels.
commandGuide.intelDesc: <cyan>AI News Intelligence</cyan> feed. AI analyzes the latest news related to the ticker and evaluates market impact.
commandGuide.gammaFlipDesc: <purple>Gamma Flip Level</purple> is the price where option dealers' gamma exposure flips from <cyan>LONG to SHORT</cyan>. Above this level, dealers <emerald>hedge in the same direction</emerald>, stabilizing markets. Below, they <rose>hedge in opposite direction</rose>, amplifying volatility. The 'Flip' distance in the VOL REGIME card is the key metric.

gammaFlip.longDesc: Price > Gamma Flip → Dealers <emerald>hedge in the same direction</emerald> → Stabilizing effect that suppresses price movement. <gold>Range-bound strategy near VWAP</gold> is effective.
gammaFlip.shortDesc: Price < Gamma Flip → Dealers <rose>hedge in the opposite direction</rose> → Destabilizing effect that amplifies price movement. <gold>Volatility spikes</gold>, stop-losses are essential.
gammaFlip.tip: Gamma Flip is <purple>the price where option dealers' hedge direction reverses</purple>. You can check the Flip distance (%) in real-time on the VOL REGIME card — when within ±2%, a volatility regime change is imminent.

topBar.title: Real-Time Market Indicator Bar
topBar.desc: The real-time indicator bar at the top of Guardian displays <gold>Fear & Greed Index</gold>, <rose>VIX (Volatility Index)</rose>, and <cyan>DXY (Dollar Index)</cyan> simultaneously. These three indicators alone provide an instant read on the overall market temperature.

fearGreed.title: Fear & Greed Index
fearGreed.desc: A market sentiment indicator calculated by CNN using 7 market metrics. Extreme fear zones signal contrarian buying opportunities, while extreme greed zones signal profit-taking.
fearGreed.extremeFear: Extreme Fear — Panic zone, consider contrarian buying

vix.title: VIX Volatility Index
vix.desc: Expected 30-day volatility derived from S&P 500 options. A key indicator that quantifies market uncertainty.
vix.low: Low volatility — Stable market, favorable for buying
vix.high: High volatility — Unstable, consider reducing positions

dxy.title: DXY Dollar Index
dxy.desc: Measures the strength of the US dollar against 6 major currencies. A strong dollar generally has negative effects on emerging markets and commodities.
dxy.tip: Strong dollar (DXY↑) tends to weaken tech stocks. Weak dollar tends to strengthen emerging markets and commodities.

topBar.guide1: F&G ≤25 + VIX ≥30 simultaneously → Panic zone, signal to start scaling in
topBar.guide2: F&G ≥75 + VIX ≤12 simultaneously → Overheated zone, consider partial profit-taking
topBar.guide3: DXY surge → Potential weakness in exporters and semis → Review defensive positions

gravityGauge.title: GRAVITY GAUGE
gravityGauge.desc: The Gravity Gauge synthesizes <gold>price action, volume, sentiment, and institutional positioning</gold> into a single 0-100 score representing market strength. A reading of 59 indicates neutral with a slight bullish bias.
gravityGauge.neutralDesc: Neutral — Wait and see, hold core positions only
gravityGauge.guide1: Gauge ≤40 → Avoid new longs, review stop-loss levels on existing positions
gravityGauge.guide2: Gauge ≥60 → Actively consider buying, especially effective at trend reversals
gravityGauge.guide3: Gauge hovering around 50 → Wait for directional confirmation, standby for events

realityCheck.title: REALITY CHECK
realityCheck.desc: Diagnose the current macro state through <cyan>PRICE FLOW</cyan>, <gold>NDX/DOW 20-day moving averages</gold>, <rose>US 10-year Treasury yields</rose>, yield curve spread (2S10S), and real interest rates (REAL). V9.0 adds <emerald>Macro Tactical Alerts</emerald> for real-time detection of bond and gold capital flight.

priceFlow.label: PRICE FLOW & Moving Averages
priceFlow.desc: Price Flow shows short-term momentum of major indices. NDX/DOW 20D shows medium-term trend health of tech and industrial stocks. 100% means above the 20-day MA.

bonds.label: Rates & Bond Market
bonds.desc: USO10Y (US 10-year) is the market-wide discount rate, 2S10S is a recession leading indicator, and REAL is the inflation-adjusted real yield. Watch for yield curve inversion.

macroAlert.label: Macro Tactical Alerts
macroAlert.desc: When capital flows simultaneously into bonds (TLT) and gold (GLD), <rose>RISK-OFF ROTATION</rose> alerts trigger automatically. This signals institutional investors moving capital from equities to safe havens — a <gold>crisis precursor</gold>.
macroAlert.riskOff: Bonds & Gold rising together → Flight to safety, equity risk management needed
macroAlert.riskOn: Bonds & Gold falling together → Risk-on appetite, favorable equity buying environment

realityCheck.guide1: Both NDX/DOW 20D at 100% → Strong uptrend, favorable to buy pullbacks
realityCheck.guide2: Persistent 2S10S inversion → Possible recession in 6-18 months, increase defensive allocation
realityCheck.guide3: <rose>RISK-OFF ROTATION alert triggered</rose> → Avoid new longs, <gold>increase cash and rotate to defensives</gold>

rlsi.title: RLSI INSIGHT
rlsi.desc: RLSI (Real-time Liquidity & Sentiment Index) provides tactical insights through AI analysis of <cyan>liquidity</cyan>, <gold>sentiment</gold>, and <emerald>technical indicators</emerald> in real-time. Only active during regular trading sessions.
rlsi.sampleInsight: Following the FOMC minutes release, the market shows growth stock preference with positive tech sector supply-demand dynamics. Rate stabilization expectations are being reflected.
rlsi.guide1: Only use RLSI insights for trading when status shows ALIGNMENT OK
rlsi.guide2: RLSI tactical insights summarize the current session environment — check before market open
rlsi.guide3: In PARTIAL status, insight reliability is lower — cross-verify with other indicators

breadth.title: MARKET BREADTH
breadth.desc: Market Breadth analyzes the <emerald>ratio of advancing to declining stocks</emerald> to evaluate the health of market rallies. If only indices rise while most stocks decline, the rally's sustainability is questionable.
breadth.guide1: A/D ratio ≥2:1 → Broad-based rally, trust the market trend
breadth.guide2: Index new highs + Breadth <50% → Rally fatigue, driven by few large caps → Caution
breadth.guide3: Breadth bouncing from lows → Bottom signal, initiate scaling in

calendar.title: ECONOMIC CALENDAR
calendar.desc: Displays schedules and expected market impact of major economic events including <gold>CPI, PPI, PMI, FOMC</gold>. Volatility can expand significantly around HIGH-rated events, making preparation essential.
calendar.guide1: HIGH event D-1: Avoid new positions, review stop-loss levels on existing ones
calendar.guide2: Right after CPI/PPI release: Ignore initial 30-min volatility, enter after 1-hour directional confirmation
calendar.guide3: 1 week around FOMC: VIX spike possible, options premium rises → Favor options selling strategies

tactical.desc: Gemini 2.5 FLASH AI comprehensively analyzes <cyan>all Guardian data</cyan> in 3 stages: <gold>Current Situation</gold>, <purple>Deep Analysis</purple>, and <emerald>Action Strategy</emerald>. V9.0 now cross-analyzes <rose>VIX futures structure</rose> and <gold>bond/gold capital flows</gold> to detect crash precursors ahead of time.

sectorIntel.guide2: Sector with trend reversal from negative to positive → Early rebound capture, preemptive entry
sectorIntel.guide3: Only top stocks rising while rest decline → Selective stock picking, avoid sector ETF

V3 adds <gold>GEX trend tracking</gold>, <cyan>SPY/QQQ individual GEX</cyan>, <emerald>Gamma Flip Point</emerald>, and integrates with <gold>Tactical Insight AI</gold> for comprehensive analysis.

gex.title: Gamma Pressure (GEX Index)
gex.desc: Combines <cyan>SPY + QQQ</cyan> options gamma exposure (GEX) into a normalized -100 to +100 index. <gold>Positive (+)</gold> means dealers hedge by buying dips → market stabilizes. <rose>Negative (-)</rose> means dealers hedge by selling dips → accelerates decline. squeeze.title: Squeeze Risk
squeeze.desc: Measures the probability that options sellers (short gamma positions) will be <rose>forced to cover (squeeze)</rose> due to sharp price moves. Above <gold>45%</gold> suggests explosive price action may be imminent; above <rose>70%</rose> is extreme danger zone.

trigger.title: Trigger Band (Options Price Walls)
trigger.desc: Analyzes S&P 500 <cyan>options chain open interest</cyan> to calculate institutional <emerald>support levels (Put Floor)</emerald> and <rose>resistance levels (Call Wall)</rose>. V3 also displays the <gold>Gamma Flip Point</gold> where dealers transition from long gamma to short gamma.

spySplit.title: SPY / QQQ Individual GEX
spySplit.desc: New in V3: displays GEX for SPY (S&P 500) and QQQ (Nasdaq 100) <cyan>individually</cyan>. Compare gamma states between the two ETFs to detect <gold>structural divergences</gold> within the market.

flipPoint.title: Gamma Flip Point
flipPoint.desc: The <gold>critical price level</gold> where dealer positioning transitions from <emerald>long gamma (stable)</emerald> to <rose>short gamma (unstable)</rose>. Distance from current price shown as %. <rose>Amber warning triggered within 2%</rose> proximity.

directionalInsight.desc: V3 replaces static insights with dynamic one-line headers containing <cyan>price targets and direction</cyan> based on current data. Instantly grasp <gold>GEX strength</gold>, <emerald>Squeeze level</emerald>, and <rose>directional bias with price targets</rose>.

aiIntegration.desc: Gamma Shield data (GEX, Squeeze, Support/Resistance) is fed directly to <cyan>Tactical Insight AI</cyan>, which generates comprehensive analysis combining RLSI+Breadth+Macro+<gold>Options Structure</gold>. AI automatically incorporates dealer gamma clamping, squeeze imminence, and options wall proximity into its analysis.

gammaShield.guide2: <rose>GEX -20 or below + Squeeze HIGH</rose> → Explosive move incoming, <cyan>directional bets</cyan> or <gold>strengthen hedges</gold>

flowGuide.level1Desc: Four core indicators are synthesized for <cyan>AI-driven directional judgment</cyan>. Based on OPI (delta pressure), ATM IV (volatility temperature), Composite Index, and Whale Position, it renders a <gold>BULLISH/BEARISH/NEUTRAL</gold> verdict.

opi.title: OPI (Options Pressure Index)
opi.desc: <cyan>OPI</cyan> measures market directional pressure by summing <gold>Delta × Open Interest (OI)</gold> across calls and puts. Positive values indicate bullish pressure, negative values indicate bearish pressure.
opi.strongCall: +50 or above: Strong call dominance → Bullish signal
opi.put: -20 or below: Put dominant → Bearish signal
opi.tip: A sudden OPI reversal can be an early signal of position change. Cross-reference with GEX Regime.
opi.guide1: OPI +50+ with GEX STABLE → Trend-following long entry
opi.guide2: OPI sharply reverses (-→+) → Early reversal signal, reassess positions
opi.guide3: OPI neutral but IV high → Direction undecided, consider straddle

atmIv.title: ATM IV (At-The-Money Implied Volatility)
atmIv.desc: <gold>ATM IV</gold> represents the implied volatility of options closest to the current price, indicating <rose>the market's expected magnitude of future price movement</rose>. IV Percentile shows the relative position of current IV versus historical levels.
atmIv.veryLow: 0-20%: Very low volatility → Cheap premium buying opportunity
atmIv.low: 20-40%: Low volatility → Favorable for option buying
atmIv.high: 60-80%: High volatility → Premium expensive, consider selling strategies
atmIv.veryHigh: 80-100%: Extreme volatility → Event imminent, risk caution
atmIv.tip: IV Percentile above 90% means IV is near historical highs. Prioritize premium selling strategies.
atmIv.guide1: IV < 30%: Buy options (calls/puts) → Profit on volatility expansion
atmIv.guide2: IV > 70%: Covered calls, put writing, or premium selling strategies
atmIv.guide3: IV spikes then declines → IV Crush in progress, consider closing long positions

composite.title: Composite Index
composite.desc: <purple>Composite Index</purple> is a weighted aggregate of OPI, ATM IV, Whale Position, GEX and other signals, <cyan>scored on a 0-100% scale</cyan>. It serves as the final basis for the AI Verdict.
composite.tip: Extreme Composite values (below 20% or above 80%) have high confidence but may also signal overbought/oversold reversals.
composite.guide1: 70%+ with positive OPI → Multiple signals align, strong buy case
composite.guide2: Crossing around 50% → Direction shift signal, consider reducing positions
composite.guide3: Below 30% with IV spike → Panic zone, hedging essential

whale.title: Whale Position
whale.desc: <emerald>Whale Position</emerald> analyzes <gold>$50K+ large option trades</gold> to determine net call/put positioning. It tracks institutional and whale directional bets to reveal smart money flow.
whale.long: LONG: Call premium > Put premium → Whale bullish bet
whale.short: SHORT: Put premium > Call premium → Whale bearish bet
whale.neutral: NEUTRAL: Call ≈ Put → Whale watching or straddle
whale.tip: When whale premium exceeds $1M, it signals high-conviction trading. Check individual trades in Classified Order Flow.
whale.guide1: Whale LONG + OPI positive → Institutional and flow aligned, trend-follow
whale.guide2: Whale vs OPI diverge → Mixed signals, confirm direction before entry
whale.guide3: Whale premium rapidly changes → Potential urgent position adjustment

flowGuide.level2Desc: Four key indicators revealing the structural health of the options market. Analyze <gold>dark pool activity, short volume, put/call ratio, and gamma regime</gold> to understand market microstructure.

darkPool.title: Dark Pool %
darkPool.desc: <purple>Dark Pool %</purple> shows the <gold>proportion of off-exchange institutional (ATS) trading</gold>. Higher values indicate active institutional block orders and can be a leading indicator of price movement.
darkPool.high: 55%+: Active institutional large trades → Preparing for significant price move
darkPool.normal: Below 45%: Retail-dominated market → Individual investor driven
darkPool.tip: When Dark Pool % exceeds 60% while price is flat, institutional accumulation is likely occurring.
darkPool.guide1: DP 60%+ flat price → Institutional accumulation, prepare for breakout
darkPool.guide2: DP surge + price decline → Possible institutional selling, manage risk
darkPool.guide3: DP low but volume surging → Retail-driven rally, watch for volatility

shortVol.title: Short Volume %
shortVol.desc: <rose>Short Volume %</rose> shows the <gold>ratio of short selling to total volume</gold>. Higher values indicate stronger downward pressure, but can also fuel short-covering rallies.
shortVol.high: 50%+: Excessive shorting → Downward pressure or short squeeze fuel
shortVol.elevated: 40-50%: Caution level → Monitor rising short selling trend
shortVol.tip: If Short Vol % exceeds 50% while the price is rising, a short-covering rally is likely in progress.
shortVol.guide1: Short 50%+ price rising → Short squeeze potential, follow momentum
shortVol.guide2: Short 50%+ price falling → Intensifying downward pressure, consider put hedge
shortVol.guide3: Short Vol suddenly drops → Short covering underway, reversal signal

pcRatio.title: P/C Ratio (Put/Call Ratio)
pcRatio.desc: <cyan>P/C Ratio</cyan> measures market bullish/bearish sentiment via <gold>put volume ÷ call volume</gold>. Above 1.0 indicates put dominance (bearish sentiment), below 0.7 indicates call dominance (bullish sentiment).
pcRatio.callDom: Below 0.7: Call dominant (bullish) → Excessive = overheating warning
pcRatio.putDom: Above 1.0: Put dominant (bearish) → Extreme = contrarian buy signal
pcRatio.tip: P/C Ratio above 1.3 indicates extreme fear, which historically correlates with higher bounce probability.
pcRatio.guide1: P/C > 1.2 with support holding → Contrarian buy opportunity
pcRatio.guide2: P/C < 0.5 with price surge → Overheating warning, take profits
pcRatio.guide3: P/C rapid change (0.5→1.5) → Sentiment shift, check for events

gexRegime.title: GEX Regime (Gamma Regime)
gexRegime.desc: <rose>GEX Regime</rose> analyzes market makers' <gold>Gamma Exposure (GEX)</gold> to determine the market's volatility structure. STABLE means price stabilization, EXPLOSIVE means potential for sharp moves.
gexRegime.stable: STABLE: +GEX environment → Market makers stabilize prices (suppress volatility)
gexRegime.transition: TRANSITION: Neutral zone → Regime shift in progress
gexRegime.flipZone: FLIP ZONE: Near GEX flip point → Volatility shift possible
gexRegime.explosive: EXPLOSIVE/EXPLODE: -GEX environment → Market makers amplify volatility
gexRegime.tip: When Flip Zone transitions to EXPLOSIVE, a major directional move is imminent. Cross-reference with Implied Move.
gexRegime.guide1: STABLE → Range-bound, iron condor / credit spread favorable
gexRegime.guide3: Flip Zone → Reduce position size, tighten stop-loss

pricePosition.title: Current Price Position Analysis
pricePosition.desc: <emerald>Price Position</emerald> shows where the current price sits between Put Floor (support) and Call Wall (resistance). Displayed as '+/- %' relative to the <gold>Gamma Flip Level</gold> — above the Flip Level is stable territory, below is unstable.

squeeze.title: Squeeze Probability
squeeze.desc: <purple>Squeeze Probability</purple> calculates gamma/short squeeze likelihood on a 0-100% scale. It synthesizes <rose>OI concentration, IV skew, whale positioning, and short interest</rose> to predict potential for sharp price moves. Above 70% is a high-risk zone.

flowGuide.level3Desc: <rose>Classified Order Flow</rose> displays individual <gold>large orders (Whale) and dark pool (ATS) trades</gold> captured in real-time. View each order's direction (CALL/PUT), size, expiry, and strike.

classifiedWhale.title: 🐋 Whale Trades
classifiedWhale.desc: Tracks <emerald>$50K+ large option trades</emerald> in real-time. Each trade shows premium, strike, expiry, and direction (CALL/PUT), allowing direct observation of <gold>institutional and hedge fund directional bets</gold>.

classifiedDarkPool.title: 🏦 Dark Pool Trades
classifiedDarkPool.desc: Displays large block trades executed on <purple>ATS (Alternative Trading System) dark pools</purple>. Used when <gold>institutions need to trade large volumes without market impact</gold>, showing print price, quantity, and exchange code.

battlefield.title: OPTIONS FLOW BATTLEFIELD
battlefield.desc: <cyan>Options Flow Battlefield</cyan> visualizes <gold>put (bearish) vs call (bullish) volume by strike</gold> as horizontal bar charts. A key chart for instantly assessing the distribution of bearish and bullish forces around the current price.
battlefield.callDesc: Right green bars → Call option volume. Longer bars = larger bullish bets at that strike
battlefield.putDesc: Left red bars → Put option volume. Longer bars = larger bearish bets at that strike
battlefield.priceDesc: Current price shown as blue line. R = Resistance, S = Support markers

flowGuide.sidebarDesc: Seven premium sidebar indicators for advanced analysis. <purple>Implied Move, Put Floor/Call Wall, Smart Money, Max Pain, IV Skew, DEX, and UOA</purple> reveal the microstructure of the options market.

impliedMove.title: Implied Move
impliedMove.desc: <purple>Implied Move</purple> is the <gold>market's expected price range</gold> derived from ATM option prices. Shown as ±%, there's a 67% probability that price stays within this range by expiry.
impliedMove.high: ±8%+: High volatility expected → Event (earnings etc.) possible
impliedMove.low: ±4% or less: Low volatility expected → Direction unclear
impliedMove.tip: When Implied Move surges before earnings, option premiums are expensive. Watch for IV Crush after the announcement.
impliedMove.guide1: IM ±8%+: Watch premium costs for directional buys, consider spreads
impliedMove.guide2: IM low = cheap premiums → Long straddle/strangle opportunity
impliedMove.guide3: IM vs actual move comparison → Consistently overestimated IM favors premium selling

floorWall.title: Put Floor / Call Wall
floorWall.desc: <cyan>Put Floor</cyan> is the strike with the highest put OI concentration (downside support), while <rose>Call Wall</rose> is the highest call OI concentration (upside resistance). They act as effective price boundaries due to market maker <gold>delta hedging</gold>.
floorWall.floor: Put Floor: Highest put OI strike → Strong downside support
floorWall.wall: Call Wall: Highest call OI strike → Strong upside resistance
floorWall.breakout: Floor/Wall breach → Gamma acceleration amplifies sharp moves
floorWall.tip: When price approaches Put Floor, expect a bounce; near Call Wall, expect a pullback.
floorWall.guide1: Near Put Floor → Sell puts (support expected) or buy calls
floorWall.guide2: Near Call Wall → Sell calls (resistance expected) or take profits
floorWall.guide3: Narrow Floor/Wall range → Directional breakout imminent, breakout strategy

smartMoney.title: Smart Money Score
smartMoney.desc: <emerald>Smart Money Score</emerald> synthesizes <gold>large trades (whale), block trades, and dark pool activity</gold> into a 0-100 score measuring institutional activity. Above 70 indicates active institutional positioning.
smartMoney.active: 70+: Active institutional engagement → Strong directional signal
smartMoney.moderate: 40-70: Moderate activity → Watching or minor adjustments
smartMoney.tip: Smart Money Score 80+ with positive OPI signals strong institutional conviction on the bullish side.
smartMoney.guide1: SM 70+ aligned with OPI → High-conviction institutional trade, follow along
smartMoney.guide2: SM surging but price flat → Institutional accumulation, prepare for breakout
smartMoney.guide3: SM low with high volume → Retail-driven rally, sustainability questionable

maxPain.title: Max Pain
maxPain.desc: <gold>Max Pain</gold> is the strike price where <rose>option buyers suffer maximum loss</rose> at expiry. Market makers theoretically have incentive to pin the stock near Max Pain, causing price convergence on options expiration (OE) days.
maxPain.below: Price < Max Pain: Upward pull → Price gravitates toward Max Pain
maxPain.near: Price ≈ Max Pain: Expiry convergence → Likely to stay near this level
maxPain.above: Price > Max Pain: Downward pull → Price gravitates toward Max Pain
maxPain.tip: Max Pain's magnetic effect is strongest during options expiration week. Start monitoring 2-3 days before expiry.
maxPain.guide1: OE week: Price < Max Pain → Call spread or stock purchase
maxPain.guide2: OE week: Price > Max Pain → Put spread or take profits
maxPain.guide3: Large Max Pain-price gap near OE → Expect sharp convergence move

ivSkew.title: IV Skew (Volatility Skew)
ivSkew.desc: <cyan>IV Skew</cyan> measures market fear/greed via the <rose>Put IV - Call IV</rose> differential. Large positive values = strong downside hedging demand (fear); negative values = strong upside expectations (greed).
ivSkew.fear: +5%+: Strong fear → Put premiums expensive, heavy downside hedging
ivSkew.greed: Below 0%: Greed → Call premiums expensive, upside overheating
ivSkew.tip: Extreme fear in IV Skew (+8% or above) can be a contrarian buying opportunity.
ivSkew.guide1: Skew +5%+: Puts expensive, sell puts (bull put spread) consideration
ivSkew.guide2: Skew negative: Calls expensive, sell calls (bear call spread) consideration
ivSkew.guide3: Skew rapid change → Cross-reference P/C Ratio for sentiment validation

dex.title: DEX (Delta Exposure)
dex.desc: <cyan>DEX</cyan> shows <gold>dealers' (market makers') net delta exposure</gold>. Positive (+) means call delta excess, requiring dealers to sell stock (upside resistance). Negative (-) means put delta excess, requiring dealers to buy stock (downside support).
dex.resistance: + DEX: Dealers need to sell stock → Upside resistance
dex.support: - DEX: Dealers need to buy stock → Downside support
dex.tip: View DEX alongside GEX Regime for a comprehensive picture of dealer market influence.
dex.guide1: Large positive DEX → Dealer selling pressure, creates selling wall on rallies
dex.guide2: Large negative DEX → Dealer buying pressure, creates floor on dips
dex.guide3: DEX rapid change → Large option position shifts, expect volatility expansion

uoa.title: UOA (Unusual Options Activity)
uoa.desc: <gold>UOA</gold> detects <rose>abnormally high volume-to-open interest (OI) ratios</rose> in options activity. This can indicate insider trading, pre-event positioning, or large-scale new institutional positions.
uoa.extreme: 5x+: Extreme unusual activity → Event or insider suspicion
uoa.tip: UOA 5x+ concentrated at a specific strike means someone is making a large, high-conviction bet.
uoa.guide1: UOA 5x+ on specific calls → Bullish expectation signal near that strike
uoa.guide2: UOA 5x+ on specific puts → Bearish expectation signal near that strike
uoa.guide3: High UOA with low OI → New position, high-conviction trade

volumeOi.volumeDesc: <indigo>Volume</indigo> shows the <gold>number of option contracts traded today</gold>. Like stock volume, it reveals how actively Calls and Puts are being traded at each strike price. Longer bars mean more <emerald>traders are betting</emerald> at that price level.
volumeOi.volumeBullet1: Call Volume surge → Concentrated bullish bets
volumeOi.volumeBullet2: Put Volume surge → Bearish hedging or downside bets
volumeOi.volumeBullet3: Volume concentrated near current price → Short-term volatility signal
volumeOi.volumeTip: When Volume suddenly spikes at a specific strike, it signals that a 'big event' is expected at that price level. This often appears before earnings, news releases, or major catalysts.
volumeOi.volumeGuide1: Call Volume > Put Volume → Confirm short-term bullish momentum before entering long
volumeOi.volumeGuide2: Volume concentrated at specific strikes → 'Key price levels' institutions are watching → Use as support/resistance
volumeOi.volumeGuide3: Volume patterns in the first 30 minutes can indicate the day's directional bias
volumeOi.oiDesc: <purple>OI (Open Interest)</purple> is the <gold>total number of contracts still alive</gold> — not yet closed or exercised. It accumulates daily and decreases when positions are closed. High OI at a strike means <rose>large capital is locked at that level</rose>, creating natural support and resistance zones.
volumeOi.oiBullet1: Call OI cluster → That price acts as 'resistance (ceiling)'
volumeOi.oiBullet2: Put OI cluster → That price acts as 'support (floor)'
volumeOi.oiBullet3: OI surge + price movement → New positions opening (trend strengthening)
volumeOi.oiTip: OI is the market's 'DNA'. When price breaks through a high-OI strike, massive liquidation can trigger sharp rallies or drops. This is exactly how a 'gamma squeeze' works.
volumeOi.oiGuide1: Strike with highest Call OI = CALL WALL → Use as resistance (price ceiling) reference
volumeOi.oiGuide2: Strike with highest Put OI = PUT FLOOR → Use as support (price floor) reference
volumeOi.oiGuide3: When OI decreases while price moves → Positions closing → Possible trend weakening
